features.feature: Sidebar of internal/external disks and volumes
Show Only Volumes / Show All Devices
features.apple: View > Show Only Volumes, Show All Devices
features.note: View menu radio items (cmd+1, cmd+2) in main.rs; volume_indices() drives the volumes-only sidebar. Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add View radio items in main.rs and a flag in window.rs sidebar() that hides Kind::Disk rows when volumes-only.

features.feature: Volume info: capacity, used, free, fs, mount point, SMART

features.note: Get Info (cmd+I) still opens a sheet, not a separate window, but is wider and now adds lsblk facts: UUID, partition UUID and name, partition type and map, disk UUID, logical and physical block size, rotational, transport, vendor, serial number, WWN and firmware revision (model.rs extra_rows, probe.rs read_lsblk). built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Open the info as its own window once the SDK has secondary windows; the sheet lists the useful lsblk fields, not all of them.

features.note: File menu items with cmd+M, cmd+U, cmd+E mirror the toolbar.
features.wire: Mirror Mount/Unmount/Eject into a File menu in main.rs main_menu.

features.feature: Erase with name, format and scheme
features.note: Erase opens a form sheet with a Name text field, a Format choice (ext4, exFAT, FAT32, NTFS, btrfs) and, for a whole disk, a Scheme choice (GUID Partition Map or Master Boot Record), then the confirmation; EraseDisk carries the scheme (core disk_format::erase_disk, parted for a DOS table). built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the DOS-table erase and the NTFS and btrfs formats on a scratch disk on the lab machine.

features.note: Check Only and Repair via privd; no streamed log details.
Disk > Partition into 2 to 4 Equal Parts sends DiskRequest::PartitionDisk. No bar editor for custom sizes or resize yet.
features.wire: Add a Partition sheet with a bar of partitions, add/remove/resize, then a privd DiskRequest::Partition (sgdisk) in bifrost-core and a toolbar button in window.rs:326.

features.note: Disk > Restore lists the volumes that fit (attach a disk image first to restore from it) and sends DiskRequest::RestoreVolume; core disk_format::restore_volume plans dd with fsync after the checks (both sides unmounted, destination writable and large enough, no overlap) and privd serves disk.restore_volume. No progress bar, only the footer's Restoring word; the file system is not grown when the destination is larger. built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Stream the copy progress to the footer, and grow the destination file system after a restore onto a larger volume.

features.note: Disk > Rename opens a form sheet with a Name text field (limit of the volume's file system), checks the request against the disks and confirms it; DiskRequest::RenameVolume plans e2label, fatlabel, exfatlabel, ntfslabel or btrfs filesystem label (core disk_format::rename_volume, tested) and privd serves disk.rename_volume. Like erase, the helper needs an unlocked session this app does not hold yet. built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Rename inline in the sidebar (Return on a selected volume); verify the label tools on a scratch volume on the lab machine.

features.feature: Create image (blank, from folder, from device)
features.note: File > New Image > Blank Image (name, size, optional ext4, exFAT, FAT32, NTFS or btrfs with a volume name, then the save panel) sizes the file and runs mkfs on it (images.rs write_blank); Image from Folder builds an ISO with hdiutil create -srcfolder (images.rs write_folder_image). From device is not done: reading a block device needs the privileged helper. built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: From device: a privileged request that reads a block device into a chosen file. Verify the blank and folder images on the lab machine.

features.note: File > Open Disk Image (cmd+O) shows the open panel (documents permission) and attaches the chosen image read-only through hdiutil attach, which binds a loop device and mounts it (flow.rs opened_path, images.rs attach_plan). Detach Disk Image already existed. built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify on the lab machine that the panel's file resolves to a path the attach tool accepts; offer read-write attach.

features.apple: Images > Convert, Resize, Scan Image For Restore; File > Change Password
features.note: Image > Convert Image writes raw, QCOW2, VMDK, VHDX or VDI with qemu-img convert (forms.rs:196, images.rs write_converted); Image > Resize Image runs truncate, e2fsck and resize2fs in the safe order (grow: file first; shrink: ext file system first), forms.rs:205, images.rs:156. Change Password (LUKS) is not done: it needs a secure text field and a privileged cryptsetup request. built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Change Password: a masked text field in the form kit and a privileged cryptsetup luksChangeKey request.

features.note: Tied to the platform container file system; btrfs subvolumes would be the analogue, not planned.

Disk > RAID Assistant: level (RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, 10), array name and tickable members in a form sheet; DiskRequest::CreateRaid plans mdadm --create (core disk_format::create_raid: minimum members, unmounted, no overlap, free name) and privd serves disk.create_raid. A created array is not listed in the sidebar (md devices are hidden), and there is no assemble, add or remove of members. built on parity/team-d-disk-utility; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: List assembled arrays (show md devices in the sidebar) and add stop, assemble and member add or remove actions.

features.note: File > Show in Files (cmd+shift+R) opens the mount point as a file:// URL via ctx.open_url (actions::mount_url, tested). Needs a check on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add a menu item opening the selected mount point in the Files app via shell open.
